unit_harmonisation.note: All elemental values are expressed in ug/g dry weight. mg/kg (as used by OSD-745) is numerically identical and requires no scaling.

overrides_applied.evidence: Taking the stated mg/g at face value gives mean concentrations of 2943% (K), 805% (Mg), 651% (Ca), 551% (S) and 367% (P) of dry weight, which are physically impossible. Interpreted as ug/g the same values agree with OSD-745, whose lettuce elemental data are independently expressed in mg/kg: Ca 5.83 vs 4.50 mg/g, K 29.4 vs 47.9 mg/g, Mg 8.05 vs 2.60 mg/g. The three elements OSD-655 labels in ug/g (Al, B, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn) require no correction and already agree across studies, which localises the defect to the five mg/g labels. OSD-655_dictionary_DataDictionary_OSD-655.csv repeats the incorrect unit, so the defect is in the curation metadata, not only the header.
